stem.text: Chromium is present in compound X.

items: Two moles of compound X react with exactly 3 moles of silicon.
The only products of this reaction are 4 moles of chromium and 3 moles of a silicon compound in which the oxidation state of the silicon is +4.
Chromium and silicon are the only elements that change their oxidation states in this reaction.
